in_marathi.name: Gautam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rishi, Seer of Truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gautam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gautam is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Gautama', which means 'seer of truth' or 'rishi'. This name is associated with the ancient sage Gautama, who is believed to have gained enlightenment and became Buddha. The name carries a deep spiritual significance and symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth.
